correctness.rationale: Both full face-generation predicates agree on all 16384 subsets and give 8851 faces. Two independent exact acyclic matchings each have 4424 pairs and one critical zero-cell plus one six-cell; both full 52304-incidence Hasse orientations are DAGs. This proves integral S^6 via discrete Morse, not mod-p inference. The explicit 128-term oriented cross-poly cycle has zero signed boundary and evaluates to 1 on the cocycle of an isolated top-dimensional face. Exhaustive Fano collineation enumeration (168 even point permutations), plus explicit duality sign, proves all 336 automorphisms act trivially.

value.rationale: Complete integral homotopy and full automorphism character of the canonical nonchordal 14-vertex incidence graph. Its nonpure dimension-9 dominance complex collapses to a six-sphere; a geometric primitive generator exhibits sharpness of the Matsushita vertex-cover connectivity inequality τ(H)=7, filling a natural topological and symmetry example not determined by the literature. The exact graph, rather than an arbitrary slice, is the smallest projective-plane Levi graph. No higher-order incidence-geometry theorem is presumed.
